# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P47](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0047), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda features a face marked with freckles and a snub nose. Her appearance is also defined by her wide mouth and broad smiles.

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Belinda is an obedient and agreeable individual who readily complies with instructions from her mistress, whom she holds dear. Known for her joyful demeanor and broad, welcoming grin, she nonetheless harbors an immense dislike for [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) and suffers from severe homesickness.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)_

## History

Belinda worked as a young helper for Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where she earned the moniker 'Belinda the Fourth'. While picking strawberries during a visit from [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), she expressed concern to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over Miss Rosalind's declining health and ongoing melancholic mood. She was later delighted when [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) arrived at the cottage and embraced [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) as a lover. Later, during a summer in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), she caught up with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returned to the area.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +14 more_

## Relationships

### [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--harcourt.md)

Belinda and [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) are close friends who live in the same household. Belinda works as a helper at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where she regularly assists [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) with daily life, household tasks, and hosting visitors. Together, they share concern for Miss Rosalind's health and happiness, delighting in her eventual romantic reunion with [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and helping prepare for her wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +18 more_

- Friend of — close friends residing in the same household  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--nell-harcourt.md)

Belinda and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends who bond during visits to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage). Belinda works as the young helper at the cottage, known as Belinda the Fourth to its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). Over time, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) often visits the cottage to spend time with Belinda and help lift Miss Rosalind's spirits, and the two friends continue to catch up when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), +10 more_

- Friend of — close friends  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
